description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the Provider Data Access Object (DAO) using Hibernate for the OpenMRS project. It provides methods for CRUD operations and complex queries related to Provider entities, including handling provider attributes, roles, and associated person names.

classes.name: HibernateProviderDAO
classes.description: Hibernate-based implementation of the ProviderDAO interface, managing provider data persistence and retrieval.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory for database operations.

methods.name: getAllProviders
methods.description: Retrieves all providers, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Obtains the current Hibernate session.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Saves or updates a Provider entity.

methods.name: deleteProvider
methods.description: Deletes a Provider entity.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Fetches a Provider by its ID.

methods.name: getProviderByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Provider by its UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson
methods.description: Finds providers associated with a specific Person, with optional inclusion of retired providers.

methods.name: getProviderAttribute
methods.description: Gets a ProviderAttribute by its ID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getProviders
methods.description: Fetches a list of providers based on name, attributes, pagination, and retirement status.

methods.name: prepareProviderCriteria
methods.description: Prepares search predicates for provider queries based on name and retirement status.

methods.name: getNameSearchExpression
methods.description: Creates search predicates matching provider names with person names.

methods.name: getCountOfProviders
methods.description: Counts providers matching search criteria.

methods.name: getAllProviderAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all provider attribute types, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getByUuid
methods.description: Utility method to fetch entities by UUID generically.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Finds a ProviderAttributeType by its name.

methods.name: saveProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProviderAttributeType.

methods.name: deleteProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a ProviderAttributeType.

methods.name: isProviderIdentifierUnique
methods.description: Checks whether a Provider's identifier is unique across the system.

methods.name: getProviderByIdentifier
methods.description: Finds a Provider by its identifier string.

methods.name: getProviderRole
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderRole by its ID.

methods.name: getProviderRoleByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderRole by its UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByRoles
methods.description: Finds providers associated with specific roles.

methods.name: getAllProviderRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all ProviderRoles, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: saveProviderRole
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProviderRole.

methods.name: deleteProviderRole
methods.description: Deletes a ProviderRole.
